findings.note: Current 'Лимит аудио' names the object (an audio quota) where the other five class labels state the failed event; the locale's settled 'rate limit' is 'лимит запросов'. Proposed 'Лимит аудио превышен' (21 chars, 3 words). Non-blocking: the label always sits above 'Генерация аудио сейчас перегружена...', which disambiguates it.

Two renderings of 'Back to X' now ship in ru: 'Назад к ...' (ui.browser.extensions.action_back, ui.agents.pages.back_to_list) and 'Вернуться к ...' here. No change recommended: the style guide's infinitive action-label rule favours the landed form and it harmonises with the adjacent 'Начать новый чат' in the same slot.

One ru word carries two English concepts in this namespace: 'Проверка' = 'gate' here and 'Проверка' = 'checking' in image_gen.cancel.checking ('Проверка расчёта'). The rendering itself is accurate for a policy gate; no change proposed, recorded so a future gate surface does not inherit an ambiguous term.
